name: Fontjoy
summary: One-click font pairing generator that uses deep-learning font vectors to suggest heading and body fonts.
description: A free web tool that generates font pairings with a single click. Pairings come from font vectors learned by a neural network: fonts are mapped by similarity and combinations are picked where they contrast in one key way. A how-it-works page explains the approach, and the font vectors are published on GitHub under the MIT license.
contains: pairings from a deep-learning model of font vectors
how-it-works page on contrast and font similarity
sample fonts: Montserrat, Lora, Hind Madurai
